title: Weighted pseudorandom generators with improved error dependence for general ordered branching programs
author: Edward Pyne and Salil Vadhan
work: Pseudodistributions That Beat All Pseudorandom Generators
source_version: Theory of Computing 22 (2026), Article 3, publisher source publication June 8, 2026; DOI 10.4086/toc.2026.v022a003

source_locator.proof_scope: Complete author argument including supplied core constructions

difficulty_reason: The new obligation constructs weighted pseudorandomness for general ordered branching programs with improved error dependence. The complete human proof expresses the path-Laplacian inverse by Richardson iteration, compresses a cancellation-structured sum of matrix products, and implements its weighted outputs with the inner INW generator under explicit space bounds. Those interacting inverse-error, indexed cancellation and generator-compression arguments form a substantive new research core; the Richardson identity and standard INW generator are attributed supporting prerequisites.
